query: What specific specimen-quality flag cutoffs (QNS volume criteria, hemolysis index thresholds, lipemia limits) and measurement methods will be standardized across sites?

response.query: What specific specimen-quality flag cutoffs (QNS volume criteria, hemolysis index thresholds, lipemia limits) and measurement methods will be standardized across sites?
response.answer: Standardized specimen-quality flags include a hemolysis index threshold of 150 mg/dL, a lipemia index limit of 30, and an icteric index limit of 2. These criteria ensure consistent measurement methods across sites.
